title: Pharmacists, pharmacy interns and pharmacy technicians must carry, post or have readily available a license issued by the Board
subtopic: License at the place of work
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(18), a pharmacist, pharmacy intern, and pharmacy technician shall carry, post on the wall of the pharmacy where he or she works, or have readily available at the pharmacy where he or she works, a license issued by the Board.
exam_relevance: Tests the three roles 247 CMR 9.01(18) binds and the three ways, joined by or, in which the license duty is met.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
